word: If I had never dropped out, I would have never dropped in on that calligraphy class, and personal computers might not have the wonderful typography that they do.
meaning: 如果我當時沒有退學，我就不會去旁聽那門書法課，個人電腦也可能不會擁有今天這麼美好的字體排版。
example: His decision to drop out ultimately led to the beautiful fonts that all computers now have.
hint:
中文解釋：用雙重假設句作整段的總結——退學這個看似錯誤的決定，連鎖帶出了整個產業的改變。
1) dropped out (v.): 退學；syn: quit school; ant: graduated
2) wonderful typography (n.): 美麗的字體排版；syn: elegant fonts; ant: plain text
pronunciation: Logical chain: If I had NEV-er DROPPED OUT | NEV-er DROPPED IN | per-son-al COM-pu-ters | MIGHT NOT HAVE.

word: Of course, it was impossible to connect the dots looking forward when I was in college.
meaning: 當然，當我還在大學的時候，是不可能向前看著就把這些點連起來的。
example: He could not have predicted back then how those unrelated experiences would one day connect.
hint:
中文解釋：承上啟下——用「連點成線」比喻說明，向前看時無法預知價值，只有回顧才看得清。
1) connect the dots (phr.): 把各點連成線、串起線索；syn: link events together; ant: see no connection
2) looking forward (phr.): 向前看；syn: anticipating; ant: looking back
pronunciation: Of COURSE | it was im-POS-si-ble | to con-NECT the DOTS | LOOK-ing FOR-ward.

word: But it was very, very clear looking backwards, ten years later.
meaning: 但十年後回頭看，一切就非常、非常清楚了。
example: In hindsight, after ten years, the connection between those events was obvious.
hint:
中文解釋：對比「向前看不清楚」——「回頭看一目了然」，強調回顧的力量。
1) very, very clear (phr.): 非常非常清晰；syn: absolutely obvious; ant: completely unclear
2) looking backwards (phr.): 回頭看、事後回顧；syn: in hindsight; ant: looking ahead
pronunciation: Emphatic: ver-y, VER-y CLEAR | LOOK-ing BACK-wards | TEN YEARS LA-ter.

word: Again, you can't connect the dots looking forward.
meaning: 再次強調，你無法向前看著就把點連起來。
example: He repeats the key idea: it is impossible to predict how things will connect in the future.
hint:
中文解釋：重複核心概念，加深印象——這是整段「connecting the dots」的精髓。
1) again (adv.): 再次；syn: once more; ant: for the first time
2) can't connect (phr.): 無法連結；syn: unable to link; ant: easily connect
pronunciation: A-GAIN | you CAN'T con-NECT the DOTS | LOOK-ing FOR-ward. (firm, deliberate)

word: You can only connect them looking backwards, so you have to trust that the dots will somehow connect in your future.
meaning: 你只能回頭看才能把它們連起來，所以你必須相信，那些點在你的未來會以某種方式連結起來。
example: Because you cannot see ahead, you must have faith that your experiences will eventually make sense.
hint:
中文解釋：核心建議——必須相信未來，即便現在看不清楚，也要信任這個過程。
1) looking backwards (phr.): 回頭看；syn: in hindsight; ant: looking forward
2) somehow (adv.): 以某種方式；syn: in some way; ant: never
pronunciation: Only LOOK-ing BACK-wards | you HAVE to TRUST | the DOTS will SOME-how con-NECT | in your FU-ture.

word: You have to trust in something: your gut, destiny, life, karma, whatever.
meaning: 你必須相信某些東西：你的直覺、命運、生命、因果，或任何你信仰的東西。
example: He urges the audience to believe in something — whether instinct, fate, or any guiding force.
hint:
中文解釋：開放式的信仰清單——不論你信什麼，都需要有所依靠，才能勇往直前。
1) gut (n.): 直覺；syn: instinct; ant: logic
2) karma (n.): 因果、業力；syn: destiny; ant: chance
pronunciation: List: your GUT | des-TI-ny | LIFE | KAR-ma | WHAT-ev-er. (short pauses between items)

word: Because believing that the dots will connect down the road will give you the confidence to follow your heart, even when it leads you off the well-worn path.
meaning: 因為相信那些點將來終會連結，會給你信心去追隨你的心，即使它帶你走上一條不尋常的路。
example: Trusting in the future gives you the courage to take unconventional paths in life.
hint:
中文解釋：信念帶來勇氣——相信未來的點會連結，就能大膽走一條少有人走的路。
1) down the road (phr.): 在未來的某個時候；syn: eventually; ant: right now
2) well-worn path (phr.): 老路、大家都走的路；syn: conventional path; ant: unconventional road
pronunciation: Build-up: be-LIEV-ing the DOTS | will CON-nect down the ROAD | con-FI-dence | to FOL-low your HEART.

word: And that will make all the difference.
meaning: 而那將會造就一切的不同。
example: That confidence and trust is what truly changes the outcome of your life.
hint:
中文解釋：有力的結尾句——呼應 Robert Frost 名詩「And that has made all the difference」，意義深遠。
1) make all the difference (phr.): 造就一切不同、至關重要；syn: change everything; ant: make no impact
2) that (pron.): 指代信任自己、跟隨內心的行為；syn: this attitude; ant: (n/a)
pronunciation: Final, quiet power: And THAT | will MAKE | ALL the DIF-ference. (slow, falling tone)
